settings.text: 3. Protect Your Brush From Toilet Flush Germs!

settings.repere: Paragraphe · We don't like to think about it, but eve
settings.text: We don't like to think about it, but every time we flush, millions of unseen germs go airborne. Yuck! Thankfully, the UMMA Diamond’s clever base station doesn’t just clean your toothbrush - it also acts as a shield, protecting your brush from those invisible invaders. Now you can brush with confidence, knowing your toothbrush is as clean as can be!
